About ShopKart

ShopKart is an online store for everyday electronics, fashion, footwear and home essentials, with prices in rupees, delivery across India, and payment by UPI, card or Cash on Delivery. Every order is quality-checked before dispatch and covered by a 7-day return policy. This storefront was built as a college group project using HTML, CSS and JavaScript.
